mapper.select:
where q.del_flag = '0'
AND (q.code ilike concat('%', #{code}, '%') or q.title like concat('%', #{code}, '%'))
AND q.publish_status = #{publishStatus}
order by q.code, q.version desc
where q.code = #{code} and q.publish_status = 'active' and q.del_flag = '0'

mapper.insert: insert into abr_questionnaire (code, version, version_label, title, publish_status, question_count, definition, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{code}, #{version}, coalesce(#{versionLabel}, ''), coalesce(#{title}, ''), 'draft', coalesce(#{questionCount}, 0), cast(#{definition} as jsonb), '0', #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update abr_questionnaire set publish_status = 'retired', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where code = #{code} and publish_status = 'active' and del_flag = '0'
